description: Golden questions for text-to-SQL. Each carries a hand-written reference query; grading compares executed results, not query text, because there are many correct ways to write each of these.

questions.question: What was the Kansas City Chiefs' pass rate on designed plays in the 2023 season?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(is_pass_call::INT) AS pass_rate FROM plays WHERE season = 2023 AND posteam = 'KC' AND is_designed_play

questions.question: Which team had the highest neutral-script pass rate in 2022?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT posteam FROM plays WHERE season = 2022 AND is_designed_play AND is_neutral_script GROUP BY posteam ORDER BY avg(is_pass_call::INT) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the league average EPA per play on third and long since 2020?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(epa) AS epa_per_play FROM plays WHERE season >= 2020 AND down = 3 AND distance_bucket IN ('long', 'very_long') AND is_designed_play

questions.question: How many drives reached the red zone and ended in a touchdown in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM drives WHERE season = 2023 AND end_yardline_100 <= 20 AND scored_touchdown

questions.question: What was the coldest game on record in this data, and what was the temperature?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT game_id, temp FROM games WHERE temp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY temp ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which passer had the best EPA per play in the 2021 season, with at least 300 plays?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT player_name FROM player_game WHERE season = 2021 AND role = 'passer' GROUP BY player_name HAVING sum(plays) >= 300 ORDER BY sum(epa_per_play * plays) / sum(plays) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many fourth-down attempts were there in each season from 2019 to 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT season, count(*) AS attempts FROM plays WHERE season BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND down = 4 AND is_designed_play GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

questions.question: What share of designed plays were run out of shotgun in 2024?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(shotgun::INT) AS shotgun_rate FROM plays WHERE season = 2024 AND is_designed_play

questions.question: What fraction of regular season games did the home team win in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg((home_margin > 0)::INT) AS home_win_rate FROM games WHERE season = 2023 AND season_type = 'REG'

questions.question: Rank the top five teams by offensive EPA per play in 2023.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT posteam FROM plays WHERE season = 2023 AND is_designed_play GROUP BY posteam ORDER BY avg(epa) DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many designed plays did the San Diego Chargers run in 2013?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season = 2013 AND posteam = 'LAC' AND is_designed_play

questions.question: How many rushing plays did the Ravens call in 2023, excluding quarterback kneels?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season = 2023 AND posteam = 'BAL' AND is_designed_play AND NOT is_pass_call

questions.question: What is the pass rate inside the two-minute warning compared to the rest of the game, across all seasons?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT is_two_minute, avg(is_pass_call::INT) AS pass_rate FROM plays WHERE is_designed_play GROUP BY is_two_minute ORDER BY is_two_minute

questions.question: What was the largest margin of victory in any game in the data?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT max(abs(home_margin)) AS margin FROM games
